reviews.text: RyRock made the unfun process of getting a new roof enjoyable and possible! Ryan was a great communicator, detail oriented, a great advocate with our insurance, completed the process quickly from start to end, personable and funny, went above and beyond with the roof/gutter replacement and made magic happen!! Two thumbs way up!! Everything looks 10 out of 10!!
reviews.author: Andrew Eenigenburg

reviews.text: RyRock Roofing & Construction really impressed us. We had another contractor replace our roof before and it was a huge disappointment — corners cut and things left undone. RyRock came in and fixed everything the right way. They not only replaced the roof but also installed new gutters and exhaust fans, and the whole crew worked clean, quick, and efficient. What stood out most was their honesty and the pride Ryan and his crew take in their work. You can tell integrity actually matters to them, and that’s rare these days. Most roofers are questionable but I’d recommend Ryrock to anyone without hesitation.
reviews.author: Devin Sarolia

reviews.text: Can’t say enough about this company, Ryan the owner is one of the most professional persons I have ever met, the inspection and recommendations he made were extremely helpful in our decision on the work needed and to make a decision on what kind of roof   we would like, once our choices were made the product was ordered, delivered and work started. The job was down  in 1 day and when finished it was beautiful. All of his men were very professional and when job was done the cleanup was spotless.I recommend this company to anyone looking to replace your roof, he knows his business and knows how to deal with insurance companies. This company is A1 and in closing my review the most impressive part of all was after 1 year Ryan called me and made appointment to come out check my roof to make sure all was secure, (no loose shingles, turbines,caulking and no pealing paint) this jester shows the professionalism of him and his company. Anyone who needs a new roof this is the company. My home is a job well done by RYROCK ROOFING AND CONSTRUCTION.
reviews.author: Mike Riley

reviews.text: I first met Ryan when I was getting information on installing some more vents on my home in Grand Prairie. He was very informative and gave me so many more options of things to do than I was aware. Well, in a bittersweet note we had a storm in March of 2023 that caused a lot of damage. Since I already had started a conversation with him, I figured it was the best place to start and I am glad I did. He guided me through the process with his experience of what I was going to expect and the preparation did help tons dealing with the insurance company. Once the dust settled and it was time to start the process, not only were we ready to go, it was done at a record speed. Also, during the process he led the charge to upgrade our patio. Now the dust has settled, the home looks great. We are saving money with insurance because the roof is newer and we spend a lot more time outside on the new patio. Thank you for transforming our house into a beautiful home!
reviews.author: Adam Hall

reviews.text:
Ryan is simply an amazing contractor and person. Am a first time customer but he was able to come out same-day to inspect my roof after I noticed a small leak. He arrived on time, identified the problem area (and a few other areas of concern) and patched everything up at no charge. He provided before and after photos of everything, and went over all his findings with me, answering all my questions along the way.

The whole experience was wonderful, will definitely be calling Ryan again for any future roofing and home construction needs.
reviews.author: Chris Copeland

reviews.text: I recently worked with RyRock Roofing and Construction. The owner Ryan was professional and very helpful in answering all my questions regarding anything roof and insurance, helped me all the way and went over and above the job. I feel very fortunate that he came highly recommended and found the company that was fair and did an excellent job. I would recommend him with my eyes closed. Plus, he hires a great crew.
reviews.author: George Palasciano

reviews.text: Ryan did my roof inspection, provided pictures and explained the damage.  He was super easy to work with and his patience was awesome!  Overall, working with Ryan and his team was great and I would definitely use RyRock again.
reviews.author: Felicia Bolden

reviews.text:
Ryan at RyRock Roofing did a wonderful job.  My longtime insurance company has changed into something horrible.  The insurance company denied my claim for 2 years.  Ryan used his toolbox and was able to secure a satisfactory claim payment.
My old roof was torn off and the new roof installed in 1 day.  The crew was very professional and obviously experienced.  The roof looks wonderful.
I am very pleased with the work and the outcome of my experience with RyRock Roofing.  I recommend RyRock Roofing.  Thank you Ryan.
reviews.author: David H

reviews.text: Great service, they came out fast and inspected my roof and was able to repair it when I thought I needed a new roof. Saved me a lot of money. Good people and top notch quality. I highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Michael Sigler

reviews.text:
Can’t recommend RyRock enough. I called Ryan because we had a leak in a tricky part of our roof, and they had done a great job replacing the roof for a family member. Ryan had someone come check it the same day, gave us a reasonable quote, and had it fixed the following day. They pulled the shingles to make sure the whole area was sealed properly, installed the proper barriers, and replaced with new shingles. They kept me appraised throughout the process about the issues and best solutions, and sent me photos of the problem areas and the work they did.
Will definitely reach out to them with any roofing needs, and will recommend them to anyone who needs roofing work.
reviews.author: Jose Queijo

reviews.text: Ryan and his guys are quick and professional, they did an amazing job on our roof. I would highly recommend them to anyone who needs some roof repairs done. We couldn’t be more happier with how everything came out.
reviews.author: Texas Watering Solutions

reviews.text: Working with RyRock Roofing was truly a great experience.  Ryan was awesome! We found him to be very genuine, and embodies a teacher's spirit. This was crucial for us as first time homeowners with lots of questions. He guided us through every step of the process and answered all our questions with grace. We were impressed by his thoroughness, clear communication, honest pricing, and overall pleasant demeanor. When Ryan and his team began replacing our roof, they worked efficiently and left our property spotless. Their professionalism even caught the attention of our neighbors, who asked for his contact information and informed us he would be working on their house next week! As someone who is very discerning about where and with whom I spend my money, I wholeheartedly recommend RyRock Roofing for your roofing needs!
reviews.author: Raaga Bean

reviews.text: Ryan is a great guy to contact, will talk you step by step how things are done. Pretty good services. Would recommend!
reviews.author: Gabriela Cruz

reviews.text: Ryan is the absolute best! He’s great at communicating and gave excellent customer service. Our roof looks amazing!
reviews.author: Denisha Leanne

reviews.text: Ryan was super easy to work with, including working directly with my insurance agent to go through the necessary repairs for our roof. We had a few hiccups during the day of the installation, but Ryan went the extra mile to ensure that all items were rectified and completed in a satisfactory manner. Overall, we are very pleased with our experience and the final outcome of this project.
reviews.author: Aaron Bickle

reviews.text: Ryan replaced the roof on my house and even helped me work with my insurance company to make it less of a hassle! The roof is beautiful and I've had no issues. He's also done a few other projects around my house with great results. I recommend Ryan and RyRock Roofing and Construction.
reviews.author: Jenica

reviews.text: RyRock Roofing & Construction was the perfect choice for my home in Irving! After suffering quite a bit of hail damage, Ryan and his team replaced the roof and put on new gutters. Ryan went above and beyond to make the whole process easy and was responsive to any questions or concerns that I had. It was a blessing to work with him!
reviews.author: Patricia Hall

reviews.text:
I first met Ryan (the owner of RyRock) when he was still working for Classic Roofing. He went to bat for me with my insurance company several times and saved me a lot of stress. So when he let me know that he was going into business for himself, I knew any time I needed any work done on the house, he'd be my first call.

Last year, I realized my fence stain was looking pretty rough, and I knew it was only a matter of time before the HOA started fussing about it, so I called Ryan. He quoted me a more than fair price, so I told him, "you're hired." The fence got pressure washed and stained and still looks AMAZING. And Ryan was as friendly, professional, courteous, and considerate as I remembered. It's so nice to find folks who are genuinely good people and who won't fleece you or your insurance company--not that the insurance company doesn't deserve it sometimes ;-)
So if you need any roofing or construction work done, definitely reach out to RyRock. You'll get quality work, a fair price, and excellent customer service.
reviews.author: Amanda Johnson

reviews.text: When we had a hail storm in my community, I delayed starting the process for a new roof. A family member referred me to RyRock Roofing & Construction and I couldn’t be happier with the outcome! Ryan, the owner, is very responsive to messages and has a fast, efficient team.  Thank you for a great experience!
reviews.author: Jen M

reviews.text: Ryan went above and beyond on our roof extension we added to our side door.  First rate service and quality.  We told him what we wanted and he and his crew came out and did exactly what we asked for.  Clean up was great no nails, debris, or trash was left behind.   Excellent service and craftsmanship.
reviews.author: Josh Wilson

reviews.text: RyRock did a great job on my roof.  The team pulled off the old roof,  placed the layment down, and finished my home on time. They cleaned my yard and left no trace but a new roof. I found quality and workmanship excellent.  I will call on RyRock again when a new roof is needed.
reviews.author: Manuel R DeReyes

reviews.text: RyRock is one of the most professional and trust worthy businesses I've ever used. They do what they say and don't raise the prices. Excellent craftmanship on all the work done. I HIGHLY recommend them and will use them for other projects in the very near future!
reviews.author: Eddie Smith

reviews.text: Ryan did an excellent job throughout the entire process. Worked with the insurance company to ensure all damage was accurate. Kept in touch with updates and any questions.  Quality of job is  top notch. Highly recommend!!!
reviews.author: Dennis Scaggs

reviews.text: Did a wonderful job  on my roof. Was very helpful and explained in detail every step of the job. Very trustworthy.
reviews.author: Anita Lazo

reviews.text: Ryan and his team did fantastic work! Very responsive, was quick to get us back in order and went above and beyond. Highly recommend giving them a call.
reviews.author: Michael Martinez

reviews.text: Great company to work with. Excellent communication.
reviews.author: Alex Sharp

reviews.text: Great service great prices. Ryan goes the extra mile.
reviews.author: Barry Eisenberg

reviews.text: Awesome job !!!!
reviews.author: Gilberto Gutierrez

reviews.text: Muy recomendable, hizo un muy buen trabajo, no me decepcionó, fue más allá para ayudar a satisfacer nuestras necesidades, cualquiera que necesite hacer su techo, le recomendará que se haga con ellos, no se sentirá decepcionado.
reviews.author: Diego Gonzalez

reviews.text: Este señor Ryan es una vuena persona trabajando el rufin se los recomiendo para el k quiere cambiar el techno de su casa
reviews.author: Jose Gonzalez
